content: FastAPI documents BackgroundTasks as suitable for small post-response work and explicitly recommends larger queue tools such as Celery for heavy work across processes or servers. Its deployment docs show worker processes, while its async guidance identifies image processing and computer vision as CPU-bound. For this low-end single-host service, keep one Uvicorn process and one scan at a time; make authoritative job state live in Node/MariaDB or Supabase, not asyncio task dictionaries.
